title: fxv cli json output format
description: Schema describing the structured output emitted by the flexvault content, including program metadata and task progress details.

program.description: Metadata about the command line utility producing this output.

name.description: Human readable name of the program.

executable.description: Fully qualified executable path or command name.

arguments.description: Ordered argument vector used for this invocation.

invoked_at.description: Timestamp capturing when the program was launched.

hostname.description: Host on which the program is executing.

pid.description: Operating system process identifier, if available.

working_directory.description: Directory from which the command was executed.

message.description: Envelope containing the command's output payload and task progress indicators.

kind.description: Identifies the command that produced this message: the dash-joined CLI command path (e.g. 'status', 'user-add'). A final message uses the bare command kind; an interim progress message uses the same kind with a '-progress' suffix. The reserved kind 'error' is emitted in place of a command's own message when the command fails, and carries the error payload.

update_frequency_seconds.description: Expected cadence, in seconds, for subsequent updates when the task is ongoing.

sequence.description: Monotonic identifier that orders progress messages for long running tasks.

payload.description: Domain specific data emitted by the command. Extend this schema with $ref to constrain the structure as needed.
